repeat_variation.note: Observed variation only; three pairs do not establish statistical significance. Small or mixed-sign changes require more evidence.

method: Alternating fresh Node processes; sampling off; fixed exported inputs; median of per-run means; not browser FPS

conditions.note: CPU throughput, not interactive FPS. Compare like-for-like unprofiled runs; sampling has overhead.
CPU throughput, not interactive FPS. Compare like-for-like unprofiled runs; sampling has overhead.

notes: wall clock timings, excluded from the observation digest
serialize is an optional canonical-JSON probe, not actual Web publication or decode time; measure those separately
luau_positive_heap_delta_bytes_per_frame is positive net heap growth, not total allocated bytes or GC pause attribution
median, p95, and frames-over-budget use the most recent bounded sample window (up to 1024 frames)

publication.note: Disjoint successful world-publication CPU spans. Excludes simulation and initial world capture; includes extra timing/collection overhead. Totals span the window; p95 uses retained samples. Not GPU or browser decode time.

window.semantics: VM-safe-point sample counts, not exact function milliseconds or call counts. Native calls and GC are not asynchronously sampled. Short functions, inlining and safe-point placement can bias attribution; compare with sampling disabled.

vm.allocation_method: Luau onallocate: sum(max(new_size-old_size,0)) on successful requests; excludes frees, allocator overhead and Rust/JS allocations
vm.gc_method: Luau paired incremental-step interrupts; includes automatic assists, excludes full collections; timing includes instrumentation overhead
vm.scope: Luau update call, including engine callbacks; manual tools and load/start are excluded
